summary: r1-f1 is fixed: the two new cases in cart_test.go pin nearest-cent rounding. Mutation check in the round worktree, reverted and re-verified green: replacing cart.go:26 with 'subtotal * (100 - discountPct) / 100' (truncation) now fails TestTotalRoundsUpToTheNearestCent (99 want 100) and TestTotalBreaksExactHalfCentTiesUp (48 want 49); the opposite mutant '+ 99' (ceiling) fails TestTotalRoundsOnceOnTheOrder (900 want 899), so the oracle pins rounding in both directions and pins the user-confirmed round-half-up tie-break against half-even. Both new cases match the brief's arithmetic (101 at 1% = 0.9999 -> 100; 50 at 3% = 0.485 -> 49) and the clamp seams at both bounds stay covered. No new problems in the delta, which touches cart_test.go only. r1-f2 confirmed still present: cart.go:26 is byte-identical in this delta, so the negative-subtotal misrounding stays a note and a known precondition of cart.Total, not something this round changed.
